fields.options: Salary Components listed here count as Basic/Wages in Site Budget's cost breakdown (e.g. Basic, Basic Salary, Hourly Earnings). Every other Earning-type component on a Salary Structure (Housing Allowance, Shift Allowance, Safety Bonus, etc.) is treated as an Allowance by default - nothing needs to be listed here for that. Employer-side Company Contribution components (SDL Contribution, Employer Provident Fund, etc.) are identified automatically from the Salary Structure's own Employer Contributions table and don't need listing here either.

fields.description: Earning-type Salary Components that represent Basic/Wages (Hourly paid or Basic Salary), not an Allowance.
fields.label: Basic/Wages Components
